scope: Read all 14 passages, overview, periods, ending and override summary. Independently reopened writing, domestic and ending sources; checked the institutional floor-date record through indexed text. This is a bounded review, not full certification of all nine sources or geometry.

sourcesChecked.result: Confirmed literal segnatted. plavtad, signed with a footprint, c.100 BCE, four shoeprints, two hands and alphabets, enslaved or possibly freed women, uncertain Detfri and unknown learning context. Correctly labelled transliteration; no fabricated original alphabet.

Confirmed red plaster and black base, lime/crushed-terracotta floor, domestic vessels and loom weights, farro and legumes in storage vessel, circular cistern with broken-tile walls. Draft does not use the source’s erroneous Oscan-foot calculation.
Indexed institutional record 3 confirms numismatic finds in floor preparation date the floor to 214–150 BCE. One small precision recommendation below.

Read final discussion: 290 campaign, remaining Samnites seeking peace and probable subordination in Roman alliance system. Draft retains uncertainty and does not equate defeat with population disappearance.

findings.issue: Coins date the floor according to TESS. The phrase 'place its construction' could be read as dating construction of the entire house.
findings.recommendation: Use 'Coins in the preparation beneath that house’s floor date the floor to between 214 and 150 BCE.' Retain the explicit later-than-map sentence.

chronologyAssessment: Later house, sanctuary and tile evidence is visibly labelled as later than the imported 500–323 BCE interval. No material anachronism found in the checked claims. Did not reopen dietary isotope article, sanctuary, citizenship or Mnamon sources.
budgetAssessment: No proposed expansion of the 200-word sanctuary source. A complete source-budget recount was outside this bounded review; parent’s reported conservative audit remains required.

corrections: Clarified that coins date the floor, rather than necessarily the whole house.
